tasks.label: Apply for a car loan

asks.label: How much you want to borrow
asks.why: We need to know how much money you're asking for.

asks.label: The car you're buying (year, make and model)
asks.why: The car you choose affects the loan we can offer.

asks.label: How long you'd like to pay it back
asks.why: This sets the size of your monthly payment.

asks.label: Your yearly income before taxes
asks.why: We don't have your income yet, and we need it to make sure the payment fits your budget.

tasks.legal_check: Because you're borrowing money, we're required to confirm it's really you, and with your permission we'll review your credit history. This check isn't part of the Tell Us Once Guarantee.

guarantee.note: If we ask for your address, phone, email or employer again, we'll credit your account $10. The identity and credit check isn't covered.

tasks.result_message: We reused 5 details you already gave us, including your employer, and needed only your loan details and income.
tasks.next_step: Add your loan details and income, then give permission for the credit check.
